parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/AudioPlayerTestHarness.swift`. The two initializers are overloads of a test harness type (`AudioPlayerTestHarness`) that differ intentionally in their dependency surface — one accepts `mockHTTPClient` and `mockAudioEngine` in addition to the parameters shared by the other. This is a deliberate fixture design pattern where the shorter overload provides a convenience entry point for tests that do not need HTTP or audio-engine mocking. Merging or abstracting them would couple unrelated test scenarios and reduce fixture clarity without any production benefit.
